detailed_description:
Continue the same realistic live-action Chinese drama, 16:9, with matched daylight, color, character identities, and restrained performances. The doctor's voice remains tied to <Audio 1> as her delivery changes from clinical reserve to private warmth. The patient's voice remains tied to <Audio 2>. All dialogue is newly performed with synchronized Mandarin lip movement.

[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 2>, still seated in his slate-blue T-shirt, looking toward <Subject 1> off screen left. Her softly blurred white-coated shoulder remains at the left foreground edge. He briefly lowers his eyes, then looks back with a polite, accepting expression. <Subject 2> (S1), using the vocal identity and timbre of <Audio 2>, says with a brief hesitation after “那”: <d>[Chinese] 好吧，那……我先回去了，谢谢主任。</d> Complete the sentence by approximately 00:03.200. He then leans forward slightly to prepare to stand.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to the established medium-wide two-shot of <Subject 3>, with <Subject 1> behind the desk on screen left and <Subject 2> on screen right. He rises naturally, moving the black chair backward a short distance with a subdued scrape. She gives one small silent nod and follows him with her eyes. He walks around his side of the desk and exits frame right by approximately 00:06.400. His footsteps recede toward the nearby exit. At approximately 00:06.600, the black smartphone on the doctor's side of the desk starts vibrating against the tabletop. She looks down toward it.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, the camera cuts to a tight desk-level insert of the vibrating phone beside the closed medical file. <Subject 1>'s right hand picks it up and taps once to answer. The vibration stops. Her right hand begins lifting the phone toward her ear, preserving the continuous physical action.

[Shot 4] At 00:08.300, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> with the phone at her right ear. Her shoulders relax and her expression softens. <Subject 1> (S2), using the vocal identity and timbre of <Audio 1> with affectionate, familiar delivery, says: <d>[Chinese] 喂，老公……</d> During the short listening pause, she raises her left wrist and glances at her watch around 00:09.700–00:10.300. Keeping the phone at her right ear, <Subject 1> (S2) continues with the same timbre referenced from <Audio 1>: <d>[Chinese] 刚好下班，你等我一下。</d> Finish by approximately 00:12.800. She lowers her wrist and holds a small private smile while listening until 00:14.000. Her husband's voice is not audible.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous quiet room ambience supports the synchronized chair scrape, clothing movement, receding footsteps, phone vibration against the desk, and phone-handling sounds. Generate these physical sounds independently of the voice-reference recordings. Use no ringtone, audible caller response, added comedy effects, or music.

混合限制‌：
所有素材（图 + 视频 + 音频）混合输入时，总数不得超过‌12 个‌！！
参考图像最多只能接入9张图像，如果不接入就用开关关掉
平台上如果用Standard 24GB显存模型运行，跑高分辨率视频可能会报错，因为显存不够，要么调节上面的chunks值到4或6，要么使用Plus模式48G显存来运行。
如果高动态场景还会出现虚影，有两个方案，一就是把调度器换成beta，跑12步，二就是保持simple跑14步，beta拟合好，但是画面颜色可能会偏浓郁，会增加一点油腻感，simple则没有。另外高分辨率分块在高动态武戏不太建议打开，会让画面产生一点轻微的果冻效应，特别是在2.0的分辨率下比较明显。
